description: The consumer resolves the package through the same bare `main`, so what it reads back is the surface emit keyed: `clamp` is green because the manifest names it at `.`, and `parseOrThrow` — unmarked, and therefore absent from a manifest that supersedes tags package-wide — floors. An empty `exports` would floor both.

diagnostics.message: Call to `parseOrThrow` escapes this `@nothrow` function: it is declared without a body — an ambient declaration, a `.d.ts`, or a value known only by its function type — and no mark, manifest, overlay, override or baseline entry colors it, so it is assumed to throw. Your outs, in precedence order: bridge this call with `try`/`catch`; assert the color in `nothrow.overrides.json`; install or write an `@no-throw/*` overlay; or, if you own the package, ship a manifest with `nothrow emit`.
